title: Allosteric communications between domains of nuclear receptors.
one_liner_zh: 该文综述核受体多结构域间别构通讯，重点涵盖LBD与DBD互作及MD模拟等结构动力学研究，虽非直接聚焦TF-DNA结合位点预测，但涉及蛋白-DNA互作机制且方法可迁移至TF-DNA体系。
abstract: Nuclear receptors (NRs) regulate gene expression in response to hormonal signals, influencing diverse physiological processes and diseases. Structural and dynamics investigations based on X-ray crystallography, cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM), hydrogen-deuterium exchange mass spectrometry, and molecular dynamics simulations, have significantly deepened our understanding of the conformational states, dynamics, and interdomain interactions of multi-domain NRs. Structural studies have examined heterodimeric complexes such as peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma (PPAR-gamma) with retinoid X receptor alpha (RXRalpha), liver X receptor beta (LXRbeta) with RXRalpha, and retinoic acid receptor beta (RARbeta) with RXRalpha, as well as homodimers like hepatic nuclear factor 4 alpha (HNF-4alpha), androgen receptor (AR), and glucocorticoid receptor (GR). These investigations highlight critical allosteric communication between ligand-binding domains (LBDs) and DNA-binding domains (DBDs), emphasizing the roles of flexible hinge regions and N-terminal segments in adapting to diverse DNA configurations. Both non-steroid receptor heterodimers and homodimers exhibit robust interdomain connections that mediate allosteric signaling. For instance, AR demonstrates three distinct conformational states that underscore its dynamic behavior, while GR exhibits unique ligand-dependent domain interactions shaping receptor signaling. The collective findings so far suggest a conserved mechanism of cross-domain communication across the NR family. Supported by complementary biophysical, spectroscopic, mutagenesis, and computational studies, this body of research has elucidated the nature of domain-domain interfaces and their pivotal roles in regulating the transcriptional activity of steroid and non-steroid receptors.
abstract_zh: 核受体（NRs）响应激素信号调控基因表达，影响多种生理过程和疾病。基于X射线晶体学、冷冻电子显微镜（cryo-EM）、氢-氘交换质谱和分子动力学模拟的结构与动力学研究，显著加深了我们对多结构域核受体的构象状态、动力学及结构域间相互作用的理解。结构研究已考察了异二聚体复合物，如过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体γ（PPAR-gamma）与维甲酸X受体α（RXRalpha）、肝X受体β（LXRbeta）与RXRalpha、视黄酸受体β（RARbeta）与RXRalpha，以及同二聚体如肝细胞核因子4α（HNF-4alpha）、雄激素受体（AR）和糖皮质激素受体（GR）。这些研究突显了配体结合结构域（LBDs）与DNA结合结构域（DBDs）之间的关键变构通讯，强调了柔性铰链区和N端片段在适应多种DNA构象中的作用。非甾体受体异二聚体和同二聚体均表现出稳健的结构域间连接，介导变构信号传导。例如，AR展示出三种不同的构象状态，强调其动态行为，而GR则表现出独特的配体依赖性结构域相互作用，塑造受体信号传导。迄今为止的集体发现表明，NR家族中存在保守的跨结构域通讯机制。在互补的生物物理、光谱学、突变发生和计算研究的支持下，这一研究体系已阐明结构域-结构域界面的性质及其在调控甾体和非甾体受体转录活性中的关键作用。
